shortDescription: Sri Lanka's consumer prices climbed 8.1% year-on-year in August, after rising 7.2% in July, the statistics department said on Monday.The National Consumer Price Index (LKNCPI=ECI) captures broad retail price inflation and is released with a lag of about three weeks each month.

children: Sri Lanka's consumer prices climbed 8.1% year-on-year in August, after rising 7.2% in July, the statistics department said on Monday.
The National Consumer Price Index (LKNCPI=ECI) captures broad retail price inflation and is released with a lag of about three weeks each month.
